en.title: Scheduled flight fare drop watcher
en.summary: Stop refreshing fares by hand: copy a Grok Bot template that checks your route on a schedule and pings you when the price drops.
en.whyItWorks: Fare checks are repetitive and easy to forget. A scheduled routine does the boring poll; you only act when the bot surfaces a drop worth reviewing.
workflowSteps: Pick origin, destination, date window, cabin, and a “notify me below” price threshold.
Create or open a Grok Bot flight-watcher template and paste those route details.
Attach a scheduled routine (daily or several times per week) to re-check the same route.
Require the bot to compare against your threshold and only alert on drops or large swings.
When alerted, confirm manually before booking—treat the bot as a watcher, not a purchaser.
en.promptTemplate:
You are my flight fare watcher.

Route:
- From: [ORIGIN]
- To: [DESTINATION]
- Dates: [WINDOW]
- Cabin: [ECONOMY/OTHER]
- Alert if price is at or below: [THRESHOLD]
- Also alert on a drop of [X]% vs last check

On each scheduled run:
1) Check current fare options for this route.
2) Compare to last recorded fare and my threshold.
3) If no meaningful change, reply briefly: “No alert.”
4) If alert criteria hit, summarize best options with price and why it triggered.
Do not book anything. Ask before any paid action.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Use a scheduled routine (daily or custom interval) for the fare check. Pair with notification/ping so you are not polling the chat yourself. Keep booking decisions human-approved.
acceptanceChecklist: The routine re-checks the same route on the schedule you attached (daily, several times a week, or a custom interval) and pings you instead of making you poll the chat.
When the fare has not meaningfully changed, the run replies briefly: "No alert."
When the price is at or below the threshold you set, or has dropped by the percent you set versus the last check, the ping summarizes the best options, the price, and why it triggered.
The bot does not book anything. It asks before any paid action, and you confirm manually before booking.

zh.title: 定时机票降价盯梢
zh.summary: 别再手刷票价：复制一份 Grok Bot 模板，按日程检查航线，降价时再通知你。
zh.whyItWorks: 查价重复又容易忘。用定时例行去做枯燥轮询，你只在 Bot 发现值得看的降幅时再出手。
workflowSteps: 确定出发地、目的地、日期窗口、舱位，以及「低于多少通知我」的阈值。
创建或打开机票盯梢模板，把航线细节贴进去。
挂上定时例行（每天或每周数次）复查同一航线。
要求 Bot 对照阈值，仅在降价或大幅波动时告警。
收到告警后人工确认再购票——Bot 负责盯，不负责下单。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是我的机票价格盯梢助手。

航线：
- 出发：[ORIGIN]
- 到达：[DESTINATION]
- 日期：[WINDOW]
- 舱位：[ECONOMY/OTHER]
- 价格 ≤ [THRESHOLD] 时通知
- 相对上次检查下跌 [X]% 也通知

每次定时运行：
1）检查该航线当前票价选项；
2）对比上次记录与我的阈值；
3）若无实质变化，简短回复「无需告警」；
4）若触发条件，汇总最佳选项、价格与触发原因。
不要代为下单。任何付费动作前先问我。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 用定时例行（每日或自定义间隔）跑查价。配合通知/提醒，避免自己刷对话。购票决策保留人工确认。
acceptanceChecklist: 例行会按你挂上的日程（每天、每周数次或自定义间隔）复查同一航线，并用通知提醒你，而不是让你自己刷对话。
票价没有实质变化时，该次运行会简短回复：「无需告警」。
价格达到或低于你设的阈值，或相对上次检查下跌了你设的百分比时，通知会汇总最佳选项、价格以及触发原因。
Bot 不会代为下单。任何付费动作前会先问你，购票前由你人工确认。
